note: Rice County park on the west shore of Shields Lake near Lonsdale (RV Life lists it as 'Shields Lake Campground'): three rows of back-in sites on open grass beside a DNR boat access, with a fishing pier, picnic shelter and playground. The lake's island is a heron and egret rookery. --Claude
summary: County page, 2026 fee schedule, rules, brochure site map and WebReserv calendar read: 30 back-in sites (20 water/electric nightly, 30/50 amp; 10 seasonal in the north row), 14x60 ft gravel pads; showers, flush toilets, dump; $30 weekday / $35 weekend (fees added); 2027 season May 7-Oct 17 (was approximate May-Oct); WebReserv booking up to 14 nights. Pin OK. Stored lakefront looks too high: downgrade candidate.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront; DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE to lakeview. Read against the brochure site map: the east end of the campground is site 20 (north row, seasonal) at about 44.3799,-93.4396, site 19 (middle row, nightly) at about 44.3795,-93.4397 and site 21 (south row, nightly) beside the loop road south of it. Site 20 and its neighbour 18 face an open mown apron that runs ~30-35 m to the base of the fishing pier (about 44.3799,-93.4393) - the open ground the stored evidence describes - but both are SEASONAL sites (not on WebReserv, $2,100 a season), so not bookable by a nightly camper. The nightly sites nearest the water, 19 and 21, are ~45-50 m from Shields Lake with a continuous band of shore trees and brush between them and the water (shore at about 44.3795,-93.4391): a view at best. No nightly site meets 'about 50 m over open ground'.

Long-stay tests: 10 of 30 sites are seasonal ($2,100 a season) and weekly/monthly rates are posted, but 20 sites are nightly, booked online, with a 14-night online limit, a fixed May-October season and the usual RV-condition rules. Not long-stay in character; a third seasonal is worth the reviewer's eye but not a drop.
Season: 05-01/10-31 (derived, approximate) -> 05-07/10-17 from the county's 2027 dates.

Sites: 18 sites on WebReserv (3-17 odd, 21-30); the map shows 19 more nightly-row sites (3-19 odd, 21-30) beside the host site, so site 19 is not sold online and the county's '20' presumably counts the host site. All back-in, pads 14 x 60 ft: a 23-ft rig fits. pull_through set false from the rules.
Pin 44.37980,-93.44000 is inside the campground rows (brochure gives 44.379821,-93.440073): OK.

Phone 507-332-6112 confirmed (facility page). Website https://www.ricecountymn.gov/facilities/facility/details/mcculloughparkcampground-1 confirmed (it refuses plain HTTP with 403; it renders in a browser).
Policy: no local-agency policy row; pets must be indoor pets and leashed; two cars per site.
